title: What I Carried in My Voice
description: In “What I Carried in My Voice,” by Nazifa Popal, Third Place Winner of the HerVoice 2026 Writing Contest, the writer reflects on a moment when language, experience, and quiet determination became tools of courage in the face of intimidation. Drawing on her work supporting women and communities in Afghanistan, the piece explores how strength is built through years of service, resilience, and perseverance rather than a single act of bravery. Through a powerful personal narrative, Nazifa honors the unseen forms of leadership that allow Afghan women to protect, uplift, and advocate for others even in the most challenging circumstances.
from: National Society of High School Scholars (NSHSS)
